_readme: Single source of truth for products. Fill in price (number, e.g. 24.99) and caffeine (e.g. "45mg") when final, then run `python3 build.py`. A null price shows 'Price coming soon' everywhere.

flavors.name: Jasmine Rose
flavors.tagline: The one you pour for company.
flavors.description: Green tea, jasmine blossom and a finish of rose, the way it's poured for guests across the Middle East, minus the sugar bowl that usually comes with it. Soft, floral, and made for sharing.
flavors.agNote: When guests came over, this was the pot that came out first. Nobody asked if you wanted tea. It was just poured.

flavors.name: Moroccan Mint
flavors.tagline: The one for the hottest day of the year.
flavors.description: Gunpowder green tea and spearmint, the way it is served across North Africa, except nobody stirred four spoons of sugar into it. Bracing, clean, and the most refreshing thing in the fridge.
flavors.agNote: Mint went into the pot by the handful, never measured. The sugar sat on the side. Turns out we never needed it.

flavors.name: Earl Grey Cardamom
flavors.description: Earl Grey's bergamot, warmed with cardamom the way tea is spiced across the Gulf, minus the condensed milk and sugar. Bright, warming and steady, made for the middle of the afternoon.
flavors.agNote: Cardamom in the afternoon pot was never a recipe. It was just how the day slowed down.
